Today has been a great day. I just completed something I had been working on for months and I'm ecstatic about the results. Writing is important to me, as written words can often better capture my thoughts and feelings than spoken words. Being able to write is a gift that gives me joy. I suspect writing will continue to help me understand myself better and provide me with the insight needed to keep growing. Some might choose to use writing as a form of therapy, while others might see it as a way to express their creativity. 


I never considered that writing could serve as such a vital therapeutic tool. It has helped me clarify my personal thoughts and feelings about a variety of topics, such as difficult relationships with friends and family. Writing has helped me to develop my own personal mantras for staying centered and focused, as well as providing a forum to accomplish multiple tasks and goals. Writing has become a key endeavor in my life, and I think it will continue to do so for the foreseeable future.
